【原视频简介】
From rusty, useless hooks to a beautiful GREEK WEAPON "Trident" the legendary symbol from Greek mythology.

This project was much harder than I expected. The shape was very complicated, and many times during forging I got confused and started thinking I wouldn’t be able to finish it. I made mistakes, lost confidence for a moment, and even thought about giving up.
But every time I looked at the steel, I reminded myself why I started. I didn’t want to stop in the middle. So I kept heating, hammering, correcting mistakes, and moving forward step by step.
In the end, this project taught me that not every build has to be perfect, sometimes the struggle becomes part of the story. And today, that rusty metal became something I’m proud of.

Watch the full video and experience the whole journey with me. If you enjoy it, please share it with friends who love forging and craftsmanship. And don’t forget to tell me your thoughts in the comments your support means a lot and keeps me creating more.

SUBSCRIBE  @OLDSMITH  to show your Love 
THANK YOU

OLD SMITH
metadata.title: 把废铁钩子锻造成海王三叉戟！｜Forging a POSEIDON's TRIDENT
